<thought>To find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a carbonyl‑ene cyclization, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break an alcohol (forming a carbonyl) and form a C‑C bond, i.e., functional_groups_broken=["alcohol"], functional_groups_formed=["ketone"], and bonds_formed=["C-C"]. This should retrieve a template suitable for a single‑step retrosynthesis of the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alcohol"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
